sources.title: Project Gigabit Network Build Contract – Northern Ireland
facts: Northern Ireland Executive awarded Fibrus a Project Gigabit contract covering over 9,000 premises.
The Northern Ireland Executive is the contracting authority for this contract.
This contract-award page is programme evidence, not a live premises orderability checker.

sources.title: Project Gigabit Network Build Contract - North East Scotland
facts: The Scottish Government awarded GoFibre a Project Gigabit contract for around 63,000 premises.
The Scottish Government is the contracting authority for Scottish local and regional contracts.
The award scope must remain distinct from current premises-level service availability.

sources.title: Project Gigabit Network Build Contract - Borders and East Lothian
facts: The Scottish Government awarded GoFibre a Project Gigabit contract for up to 10,700 premises.
The page identifies Borders and East Lothian as the intervention geography.
An awarded contract does not prove that every named premises can currently order service.

sources.title: Project Gigabit network build contract – Lincolnshire and East Riding of Yorkshire
facts: BDUK awarded Quickline a contract initially covering around 72,000 premises.
